test_contract: Public digest execution passes CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 to the fixed native summarizer and publishes returned text. Oracle: Chokidar documented environment override, confirmed in installed CLI 2.1.331. Rejects missing override or inherited CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=0.
native_reproduction: Unmodified product timed out at 120 seconds; native sample blocked in FSEventStreamStart/register_with_server; no summary.
counterfactuals: Safe mode still timed out; polling call returned a summary at 66 seconds. Native polling sample still observed another direct file watcher, so this is a scoped mitigation for Chokidar initialization, not a repair to the host FSEvents service.
native_verification: Modified product returned 0 and published nonempty summary in 74.24 seconds. Native diagnostic reports dispatch to firstParty model=claude-haiku-5-5; served-model metadata is not exposed in fixed text mode.
native_launchd: Not attempted: phase prohibits system-state changes outside worktree. Existing acceptance remains untested.
scope: Only Test phase. No linter, formatter, static analysis, full repository suite, pipeline control, delivery, auth modification or launchd registration.
discarded_verification: Earlier concurrent targeted run exited 1 after source edits changed bytes while Bash was reading the script; invalidated rather than treated as product evidence. Stable-source rerun passed all 18 cases.
documentation: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paulmillr/chokidar/4.0.3/README.md#performance documents CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1; installed Claude 2.1.331 also reads that exact env variable in its embedded watcher implementation.
